glossary.definition: Few-shot means giving an AI model a handful of examples of exactly what you want directly in your prompt, so it can pick up the pattern on the spot without any retraining. It's like showing a new employee two or three correctly filled-out forms before asking them to fill out the next one themselves, rather than making them guess the format cold.

items.title: Agentic AI Foundation adds four more open-source AI tools
items.summary: The Agentic AI Foundation, a consortium that maintains open-source artificial intelligence tools, today took four new projects under its wing. The technologies were donated by OpenAI Group PBC, Anthropic PBC, Hugging Face Inc. and Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. They bring the total number of projects maintained by the AAIF to 10. That’s up from the three the group managed when it was launched by the Linux Foundation last December.

items.title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
items.summary: Should OpenAI command an over $1 trillion valuation with this round, it would break records as the most highly valued private company ever. OpenAI is reportedly close to securing another mega round of private funding, rather than plowing ahead with an IPO. The AI lab is working on raising up to $30 billion at a $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation in a round led by Coatue and investors in UAE, sources told CNBC . This follows a similar report by Bloomberg a month ago which said the AI lab was working on raising $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation.

items.title: Canva’s first AI image model plans designs before generating them
items.summary: Canva is diving even deeper into AI with the launch of an image generation model that competes directly with those from OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google. The model, called Canva Craft , uses a two-stage architecture that allows it to plan a design before generating an image, allowing for "greater precision, consistency and control," according to an announcement on Thursday . Canva Craft can generate images at up to 2K resolution and in more than 30 aspect ratios. In addition to generating social media posts and marketing content, it's also supposed to create realistic scenes, digital art, environmental imagery, and more.

items.title: Designing an AI serving harness built to last
items.summary: The next competitive advantage in enterprise AI has less to do with which model you choose than with what you build around it. That’s an important shift. For the past several years, much of the AI conversation has centered on model capability: bigger models, better reasoning, larger context windows, higher benchmark scores. Those advances have been extraordinary.

items.title: GitLab critical patches include one for a bug that allows code execution by unauthenticated users
items.summary: GitLab on Wednesday published updated versions of its Community Edition (CE) and Enterprise Edition (EE) that address a dozen bugs and security issues, including some that allow various unauthenticated actions. The most serious of the security issues, labeled critical in severity, is CVE-2026-110264 , an integer overflow issue. “GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server due to integer overflow when compiling a specially crafted regular expression,” GitLab said in its bulletin . 1.

items.title: The Social Society Helping Women Join the AI Boom
items.summary: WIRED spoke with the founders of the Aged Intelligence Society, a fast-growing events startup that brings women together to “solve midlife problems using frontier tools.” I’m not even going to try to pretend I don’t have a bit of a girl-crush on Shoshana Berger. She’s a former WIRED editor turned editorial leader for companies like Notion and Ideo. She’s super smart and chic.

items.title: Major US banks are locking out AI agents that log in with customer credentials
items.summary: S. banks, sometimes without direct instructions. Morgan Stanley has blocked agents, while other banks are restricting access. Most plan to limit agents to read-only access. AI agents are using customer-provided credentials to access bank accounts without bank approval.

items.title: Anthropic rolls out Claude Duet, but enterprises aren’t ready
items.summary: The generative AI vendor released the app with stringent security guardrails for using it in professional and small business settings.

items.title: eMudhra to Exit Global SSL/TLS Certificate Business
items.summary: Bengaluru-based eMudhra will exit its global SSL/TLS certificate business after a security incident prompted Google, Mozilla, and Apple to block affected certificates. The company said on Thursday that its board decided to exit the business, which contributes around 1% of its global revenue, and focus on enterprise software and other digital trust services. The decision follows the discovery of eight eMudhra certificate authorities with weak private keys that could potentially have allowed attackers to create fake website certificates and impersonate legitimate websites. The eight compromised private keys were the numbers—-4, 56, 66, 115, 155, 156, 230 and 237.

items.title: Reach new heights of laziness by burning tokens to let an AI tap your smartphone screen for you
items.summary: Why use your smartphone when AI can do it for you? We’ve reached a new level of AI inanity with the launch of Opposable, a tool that taps, swipes, and types on Android phones and controls iPhones through a companion computer, sparing users the apparent burden of operating their own devices. If you don't want to update a calendar event, start a timer, or enable dark mode, you can apparently use an AI agent app on your computer (any client that supports MCP will do) to have Opposable do the thing for you on a connected phone. You could just do it on your computer, of course, but that’d require actually using your hands - like it’s some sort of baby’s toy.

items.title: The new human-crafted Apple Music brand matters in an AI world
items.summary: Apple just revealed a new brand identity for Apple Music, with the expected turn to Liquid Glass. I’m not much of a fan of their new design language in general; this is where I admit that I’m still running MacOS Sequoia and have grumpy things to say about rounded corner radii and text legibility. It’s just a trend, it will pass, and at some point I’ll probably cave and upgrade when it starts actually affecting my ability to get work done, or more importantly get security updates. Once I adjust, I’ll stop noticing it, and life will go on.

items.title: Remediation in the era of AI: Fix what matters first
items.summary: Every IT and security team knows the feeling of opening a vulnerability report and seeing a number that only goes up. Thousands of findings. Hundreds marked critical. A backlog that grows faster than any team can close it. For years, the default response has been to work harder: more scans, more tickets, more overtime.
